electrical_definitions.total_phase_kw: R phase + B phase + Y phase
electrical_definitions.total_appliance_kw: sum of every non-phase electrical channel, including lights/fans, mixed and unnamed submetered circuits
electrical_definitions.residual_kw: total_phase_kw - total_appliance_kw on timestamps with all inputs valid
electrical_definitions.positive_residual: Possible unmetered or unmapped load; not proven standby or avoidable energy
electrical_definitions.negative_residual: Retained signed for reconciliation review; not converted to positive load
electrical_definitions.A701_phase_alias: Main Incomer is the R-phase channel in the supplied workbook
